mode_help: Submit code for a teacher to review and grade.
policy_change: Assessment changes apply to new submissions. Previous results stay in history.
notice: This problem cannot be automatically graded. Please ask your assigned teacher to grade it manually.
practice: Practice submission saved. Not automatically graded.
invalid: Enter a score within the maximum, with up to two decimal places.
conflict: The assessment may have changed. Reload the saved assessment before trying again. Your input is preserved.
teacher_hint: Grades apply to the saved submission.
editing_private: You are testing a private copy. The student’s submitted code is unchanged.
readonly_hint: Only authorized teaching staff can publish a grade.
unsaved_grade: Your grading changes have not been saved. Leave this submission?
saved_submission_hint: Live edits do not change this submitted code.
newer_submission: A newer submission is available. You are grading the submission shown here.
publish_help: Your student will see this score and feedback.
talk_teacher_pending_help: Your code is saved. Let your teacher know you are ready for a review. You can use Request help above if you need assistance.
reason_example: For example: The student completed the remaining requirements.
reason_help: Add a note only if you want to explain this update.
graded_next_help: Your teacher has graded this problem. Review their feedback, then continue to the next problem.
